description: Flow-map pass rules for switcher layout and interaction equivalence

F1.name: Section order parity
F1.description: Sections appear in the exact WinForms order

F2.name: Task step parity
F2.description: Each task has the same step list (controls, order, count)

F3.name: Step region parity
F3.description: Each step in the same region

F4.name: Spatial relation parity
F4.description: Any two step controls visible together keep their left/right and above/below relation (centre deltas under 8 px count as equal)

F5.name: Scroll budget parity
F5.description: Scrolls to reach each step are no more than in WinForms. Scroll count = for each scroll container moved, ceil(px moved / container visible height), summed

F6.name: Row structure and copy fidelity
F6.description: Row structure and the copy of Must have 4 word for word, effort lists supported-only

F7.name: Region relations at both sizes
F7.description: Region relations at both sizes: status above cards and detail; cards left of detail (with the sidebar docked at 1180x700); guide at the right end of status; apply below the role box inside detail; message below cards and detail
